components.description: Federal FMLA leave as adopted in the Board of Regents Handbook (T4 Ch3 secs. 19.6 and 21) and UAM 2,673: 12 workweeks of job-protected leave in a rolling 12-month period for birth and newborn care, adoption or foster placement, care of a spouse with a serious health condition, or the employee's own serious health condition. Unpaid in itself; available sick and annual leave must be used first (c3, c4).
components.mechanism_note: Statutory leave (FMLA); pay during it comes from the faculty member's own sick and annual balances (c3, c4).
components.faculty_group_note: UAM 2,673: 'A faculty member who qualifies under the Family and Medical Leave Act'; Board Handbook T4 Ch3 sec. 21: 'Professional staff is entitled to take leave in accordance with the Family and Medical Leave Act' (professional staff includes university instructional faculty, sec. 2).
components.eligible_parent_wording: for the birth of a child, and to care for the newborn child; for placement of a child with the faculty member for adoption or foster care; to care for the faculty member's spouse ... with a serious health condition; or because the faculty member is unable to perform ... due to of a serious health condition
components.service_requirement: employed by the NSHE for at least 12 months and in paid status for a minimum of 60% FTE averaged over the preceding 12 months (statute: 12 months and 1,250 hours, 29 U.S.C. 2611(2))
components.dual_employee_rule: statute: spouses employed by the same employer may be limited to a combined 12 workweeks for birth or placement (29 U.S.C. 2612(f)); not restated in the institution's documents
components.entitlement_note: Statutory entitlement; 'is entitled to a total of 12 workweeks'.
components.medical_certification_note: HR practice sheet (summary): 'Certification of the need for leave (FMLA Form 2) will come from the physician or the Department of Family Services (adoption).'
components.duration_note: 'a total of 12 workweeks of leave during a rolling 12-month period' (R13: a total with no qualifying word -> exact). The HR practice sheet (summary) says 'up to 12 weeks' and 'A maximum of 12 weeks, reduced by any FMLA time used in the preceding 12 months'.
components.pay_fraction: unpaid (paid only from the employee's own accrued sick and annual leave, which must be used first)
components.relief_note: R9 (formal leave, relief not stated in the governing documents). The HR practice sheet corroborates: 'The faculty member has the right under FMLA to take up to the full 12 weeks consecutively. In that case is the responsibility of the department to cover the person's duties during that time.'
components.time_window: birth or placement leave expires 12 months after the birth or placement (29 U.S.C. 2612(a)(2)); HR sheet: 'can be used anytime up until the child's first birthday'

The appointment is held during it and ends if the member still cannot return. Leave component under U6; its pay is c7.
components.mechanism_note: U6: the text grants a leave status for a stated period ('extended salaried sick leave' 'for the extension period', after which 'the appointment shall be terminated'), so the leave (here) and its pay (c7, within) are two components.

components.entitlement_note: V2: 'may petition for, and may be granted, with the approval of the President'; also conditional on the funding source.

components.duration_note: U8: the member with two years (24 months) of service is in the 'more than twelve months and up to twenty-four months' band: 3 calendar months. The next band (more than 24 up to 36 months) is 6 calendar months (duration_max); more than 36 months: 12 calendar months plus 1 per full year of NSHE employment. 'may be granted less than the maximum' -> up_to. Lifetime maximum 12 calendar months plus 1 per full year of employment. For employees with under 12 consecutive months of service the Board provides instead unpaid sick leave not to exceed three months at the President's discretion (T4 Ch3 sec. 19.8; UAM 2,673 'Unpaid Sick Leave'): recorded here, not as a component, because the member described (two years of service) is not on that path (U8).

components.faculty_group_note: HR practice sheet: 'All faculty members on A and B contracts'.
components.eligible_parent_wording: give birth to a child, or whose spouse or partner is giving birth to a child, or who adopt or otherwise add a child as a legal dependent into their household; independent of gender
components.entitlement_note: R12: at the unit's discretion, with the reduction negotiated in advance; no minimum stated. The statute permits intermittent birth leave only by agreement.
components.pay_fraction: time off charged to the member's accrued sick (and annual) leave

sequence.note: A way of taking the FMLA leave (c1); it may span more than 12 calendar weeks at a reduced fraction.

flags: ambiguous: the negotiated reduction in teaching load is stated only in the undated HR practice sheet; the statute and UAM 2,673 mention intermittent FMLA leave

notes: 2018_01 is the Board Handbook T4 Ch3 and 2018_03 the Code T2 Ch5. No file is an index-only page; 2018_00 and 2018_08 are HR summaries (undated), the rest governing documents.

Governing documents present (The no-policy coding (`missing`) does not apply): the NSHE Board of Regents Handbook T4 Ch3 (professional staff, which by sec. 2 includes university instructional faculty) and UNR Administrative Manual 2,673 set faculty sick, FMLA and child-rearing leave; NSHE Code T2 Ch3 and UAM 2,723 set the tenure clock. missing = false.

There is no paid parental leave: the HR sheet says 'Parental leave is not a separate allocation of leave'; time off is FMLA (c1, unpaid) paid from the faculty member's own sick leave (c3) and, for 12-month faculty, annual leave (c4), followed by up to one year of unpaid Child Rearing Leave (c2).

System and campus restatements: where the UAM restates a Board/Code provision (child-rearing leave, FMLA, sick leave, tenure clock, leave without salary), the provision is coded once with both documents in doc_ids, since the texts give the same benefit (V3c's purpose: the more generous counts and neither adds). The only wording difference that bears on a value (child-rearing approval) is recorded in c2's entitlement note and flags.

Birth parent chain: FMLA 12 workweeks (c1; own sick leave c3 and annual leave c4 within it, then unpaid) -> Child Rearing Leave up to 1 year (c2, consecutive_after c1). With discretionary provisions, extended salaried sick leave (c6 leave with its pay c7 within) may follow exhaustion of sick and annual leave (consecutive_after c3, c4), for a physician-certified inability to work.
Non-birth parent chain: FMLA 12 workweeks (c1; own sick/annual leave within) -> Child Rearing Leave up to 1 year (c2, consecutive_after c1). Family sick leave (c5, own balance, 15 days) is unlinked.
U8 path: unpaid sick leave of up to three months for employees with under 12 consecutive months of service (Board T4 Ch3 sec. 19.8; UAM 2,673) is recorded in c6's duration_note, not as a component.

Not components (cannot be used for a birth, or not available to faculty): family death leave (10 days of sick leave), military leave, judicial leave, sabbatical leave, administrative leave, presidential leaves, entrepreneurial leave, faculty development leave (UAM 2,681, summarised on the HR page), presidential and vice-presidential transition leaves, fitness-for-service placement on leave, unauthorized leave without pay (T4 Ch3 sec. 47).

Version notes: UAM 2,670 (annual leave) is the May 2015 version captured 2015-09-05; the next capture is stamped November 2018, so an intermediate revision cannot be excluded (c4 flagged version_uncertain; it affects no counted figure). UAM 2,673 (Sept 2017), 2,723 (Sept 2013) and 2,678 (Sept 2009) are 2019 captures of versions dated before the reference date.
Medical certification for sick leave: Board Handbook allows it for absences over five consecutive days, UAM 2,673 (Sept 2017) over three days; recorded in c3's note.

Cross-references and numbering: the HR page and NSHE Code 5.10.1 cite Title 4 Chapter 3 by older section numbers (sick leave as sec. 17/18, extended sick leave as 'Section 18 (7)'); in the saved Rev. 272 these are secs. 19 and 19.7. UAM 2,673 cites Code T2 Ch5 sec. 5.10 for termination after unpaid sick leave (saved, 2018_03).

Documents cited but not saved: 29 C.F.R. Part 825 (FMLA regulations); State of Nevada 'Overview Family and Medical Leave Act of 1993, revised August 18, 2000'; Board of Regents Handbook T4 Ch3 Appendix (cited for FMLA on the HR page); NSHE Code Title 2 Chapter 6 (discipline; cited as not applying to terminations after leave); UNR Bylaws and department/college bylaws (tenure procedures); UAM 2,681 Faculty Development Leave; Board Handbook Title 4 Chapters 1, 7, 10, 11, 12 and 24, and the Procedures and Guidelines Manual Ch. 19 sec. 5 (unrelated to leave); DRI Bylaws.

Calendar: the Board Handbook states university teaching loads 'each semester' (semester calendar), so calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order. The HR practice sheet's case study mentions 'an 18 week semester'; it is an illustration in an undated summary and not used.

No leave_limits and no all-sources cap: the only stated maxima are each leave's own length (FMLA 12 workweeks, child rearing one year, extended sick leave bands and its lifetime maximum, flagged on c6).
